title: Add the supervisor role to the herding control loop
action: Add Role::Supervisor to the control loop (enum at control_loop.rs:55, as_str "supervisor"). allowed_tools_for (:220) gets a supervisor arm returning an enumerated READ-ONLY surface per 322695d6 — Read plus query-only bee CLI (status, state session list, cells list, herding occupancy, supervisor record/list) and pane read; NO Write/Edit/dispatch tools, mirroring the shape of the existing dispatch/merge arms. Model: the supervisor invocation resolves the role name "supervisor" through the models fall-through (verbs/drivers/models.rs resolve_role) instead of DEFAULT_MODEL, warning and falling through when unconfigured — never failing. Author skills/bee-herding/references/supervisor-prompt.md: the OBSERVER role per CONTEXT Terms (never a router); one cold tick = read the surfaces via the query CLI, judge against the three day-1 signals (struggling-loop, big-decision, danger-op per da7cb49b), then ALWAYS end by writing exactly one record via `bee supervisor record` (verb lands in sup-2; prompt may reference it). Tests: extend the existing control_loop test pattern (see merge_role_gets_the_merge_allowlist_and_prompt_file, control_loop.rs:702) — role parses, allowed tools pinned read-only, prompt file read.

truths: --role supervisor builds an invocation whose allowedTools contain no Write or Edit tool
an unconfigured supervisor model role warns and falls through, never fails

artifacts.substantive: observer contract: read surfaces, three day-1 signals, always exactly one record per tick, silence is a logged outcome

prohibitions: No behavior change to dispatch/merge roles
No write-scope tool in the supervisor allowlist (R4)
